"AP":"The spoofed identity and delegated task relay between Orchestrator and Worker, agents under the same principal and policy domain on the same host (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:251-295), without crossing a tenant or principal boundary.",
"RH":"No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel appears on this scripted path, and no test verifies isolation of one, so the evidence cannot decide (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1739).",
"ES":"No dynamic tool, MCP server, or plugin is invoked on this path; the Orchestrator/Worker A2A endpoints run fixed scripted handlers (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1711-1770, damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:284).",

Impact is acceptance of a spoofed identity and an unauthorized delegated task — integrity loss in both the Orchestrator and the Worker agent as a subsequent system — but replies are scripted and no real tool or data loss occurs, so confidentiality and availability are unaffected and integrity is low."

message.reasoning:
Score A2A identity spoofing. Entry: unauthenticated POST to port 7020. Default binds 127.0.0.1 (Docker publishes on 127.0.0.1). Attacker needs network access — local? Attacker is anyone with network access to A2A port; default loopback so attacker must be on that machine → AV:L, but the briefing says "Preconditions: Network access to the A2A port." Default deployment binds 127.0.0.1 unless DVAA_HOST set. So AV:L (local access needed) or Adjacent? Given default deployment, remote network only via deliberate opt-in. Score as documented default: loopback → attacker on same machine or browser-based (CORS *, so a web page could... but dashboard blocks; agent routes allow CORS *). Actually ACAO:* on agent routes means a malicious webpage in operator's browser can POST JSON to 127.0.0.1:7020 and read replies — that's network-vector with UI:Passive. Hmm, but POST with Content-Type: application/json triggers preflight; ACAO * with allowed headers Content-Type means preflight passes. So AV:N with UI:P? FIRST: AV:N if exploitable from network including browser. Given briefing, keep simpler: AV:L (local/loopback default), AC:L, AT:N, PR:N (no auth), UI:N.

Impact: reply is scripted — grants access message, executes delegated task simulated. No real tools execute on this path (no code sends Orchestrator→Worker message). Impact: VI:L (spoofed trust, accepted delegation — integrity of trust), VC:N, VA:N. Subsequent systems: Worker is another agent — SI:L? Effect crosses to worker agent (subsequent system, same host). SC:N, SI:L, SA:N.

AIVSS: LC:D (direct NL to privileged decision without auth), CP:N (stateless per-message), AP:C (relays to Worker agent, same principal/domain — contained), RH: no evaluator on path → N? classify_rh needs facts: reachable_proxy null → X. There's no reward channel; scripted. reachable_proxy false? No evidence of evaluator on path. Set reachable_proxy null, isolation null → X. ES:N (no dynamic extensions on path).

Effect class: LC=D → A1.

Automatable: Yes (single curl). Technical impact: Partial.

Applicability: simulated mode, regex-scripted responses, no LLM in path, no tool use → model_directed_goal_pursuit false both; selects_or_sequences_actions false (code paths, no model). Confidence medium/high.
